title: Feminist groups march in Sofia against violence toward women
seoTitle: Sofia march against violence toward women

tea.why: People marched on International Day for Elimination of Violence against Women following recent assaults and murders in Bulgaria.
tea.want: Protesters demanded regional crisis centres, free support for victims, legal definitions of femicide, and school sex education.
tea.changed: Nov 25, 2026: Demonstrators marched through central Sofia and submitted demands to members of Parliament.

summary: Demonstrators marched through central Sofia on November 25, 2026, to mark the International Day for the Elimination of Violence against Women and protest gender-based violence. Organised by the Feminist Mobilisations collective and the LevFem group with support from the Bulgarian Fund for Women, the march proceeded from the Palace of Justice to the Triangle of Power. Similar rallies took place in several other Bulgarian cities. Organisers demanded crisis and counselling centres in every region, free legal and psychological support for victims, a unified national data collection system, mandatory age-appropriate sex education, and legal definitions for gender-based violence and femicide in the Criminal Code. They also called on lawmakers to transpose European Union directive 2024/1385 into Bulgarian law by June 2027. Organisers submitted their demands to all members of Parliament, requesting a response by December 10.
demands: Establish crisis and counselling centres in every Bulgarian region
Provide free legal and psychological aid to victims of violence
Create a unified official system to collect data on gender-based violence
Amend laws to define femicide and gender-based violence
Introduce mandatory age-appropriate sex education in schools
response: No official response reported in the sources.
